old.text: After a loading job, {name} spends the night sorting the boss’s endless group messages. He calls it Pentagon-style management. Nobody is sure who invited the pizza delivery driver.

new.text: After a loading job, {name} spends the night sorting the boss’s endless group messages. He copied the Pentagon’s bombing-plan chat. Nobody is sure who invited the pizza delivery driver.

old.text: {name} loses sleep after a temp boss copies the Signal scandal: rota, payroll, everyone’s phone number, one chat. He says it’s secure because the group has a padlock emoji.

new.text: {name} loses sleep after a temp boss copies the Signal bombing-plan scandal: rota, payroll, everyone’s phone number, one chat. He says it’s secure because the group has a padlock emoji.

old.text: Another War Department reorganization lands. Officials order new signs before checking the equipment. Your van has nominated its rattle for a leadership position.

new.text: Trump’s War Department branding brings another reorganization. Officials order new signs before checking the equipment. Your van has nominated its rattle for a leadership position.

old.text: Book-panic bulletin: officials promise freedom from classroom “indoctrination.” The approved reading list arrives pre-approved, with instructions on how freely to discuss it.

new.text: Book-panic bulletin: officials copy Trump’s ban on classroom “indoctrination.” The approved reading list arrives pre-approved, with instructions on how freely to discuss it.

old.text: Officials demand a more flattering account of American history. The museum’s new slavery exhibit consists of a very attractive curtain.

new.text: Trump’s flattering-history directive reaches the museum. The museum’s new slavery exhibit consists of a very attractive curtain.

old.text: A new travel restriction demands proof you belong here. The van’s registration, your accent and your patience are called forward separately.

new.text: Trump-style extreme vetting demands proof you belong here. The van’s registration, your accent and your patience are called forward separately.

old.text: The battery dies halfway through “American energy dominance” on the radio. The slogan finishes on your phone. National abundance has terrible coverage.

new.text: The battery dies halfway through Trump’s “American energy dominance” speech. The slogan finishes on your phone. National abundance has terrible coverage.

old.text: The fuel pump fails. The tank has fuel; the engine can’t get it. “Drill, baby, drill” is an unusually loud answer to the wrong question.

new.text: The fuel pump fails. Trump’s “Drill, baby, drill” plays on the radio. Finding more oil is an unusually loud answer to the wrong broken part.

old.text: Someone offers a battery for supplies at the exchange. The radio promises American energy independence. You ask if that includes starting the van.

new.text: Someone offers a battery for supplies at the exchange. Trump promises American energy independence on the radio. You ask if that includes starting the van.

old.text: At the exchange, someone offers supplies for your tire. You agree on the value without announcing a trade war. Both economies survive the conversation.

new.text: Someone offers supplies for your tire. Trump calls tariffs a brilliant negotiating tool. The trader points at the food. “Or we could both leave with something.”

old.text: A resident offers a tire for supplies. The crew jokes that Washington calls this access: bring something valuable and suddenly there’s room at the table.

new.text: A senator’s donor-dinner ad plays at the exchange. A resident offers a tire for supplies. “I can also listen to your concerns,” she says, “but the tire’s extra.”

old.text: A shop offers $18 to unload a delivery delayed by broken local access roads. The owner calls it Infrastructure Week. The driver calls it Thursday.

new.text: A shop offers $18 to unload a delivery delayed by broken local access roads. The owner calls it Trump’s Infrastructure Week. The driver calls it Thursday.

old.text: At the D.C. hearing, the chair gives you two minutes. A donor dinner is penciled in for three hours. Apparently chicken needs more representation.

new.text: At the D.C. hearing, the chair gives you two minutes. His political donors get three hours over dinner. Apparently chicken needs more representation.

old.text: At the D.C. hearing, a donor’s envelope gets its own chair. You stand at the public microphone. Unlimited independent spending has developed excellent posture.

new.text: At the D.C. hearing, a political donor’s envelope gets its own chair. You stand at the public microphone. Unlimited independent spending has developed excellent posture.

old.text: Cold exposure ends the journey. Washington’s energy-dominance speech continues in a heated room. The microphone is wearing better weather protection than the public.

new.text: Cold exposure ends the journey. Trump’s energy-dominance speech continues in a heated room. The microphone is wearing better weather protection than the public.

old.text: Heat exposure ends the expedition. The radio is still celebrating energy dominance. Somewhere, the air conditioner cooling that announcement is working very hard.

new.text: Heat exposure ends the expedition. The radio is still celebrating Trump’s energy dominance. Somewhere, the air conditioner cooling that announcement is working very hard.

old.text: You lose the final vote. The chair invokes the government’s preferred, uplifting version of America. Your case is removed from the table before the photograph.

new.text: You lose the final vote. The chair invokes Trump’s preferred, uplifting version of America. Your case is removed from the table before the photograph.
